MEASURED: the scale gate has EXCEEDED its 30-minute runtime limit. 33 min 40 s elapsed since the fixture-ready signal, still running, worker CPU 27 min 16 s. runtime_pass will be FALSE.

Memory was never the constraint: peak RSS about 2.4 GiB against the 4 GiB budget and falling under gc, now 2.04 GiB. This path is runtime-bound.

It failed in the most favourable configuration available - q=2, three partitions, six edges, covariance singular for 84% of supports. Both fixes for that degeneracy multiply the dominant cost 5-6x, so a statistically meaningful fixture is further outside the gate.

Your acceptance clause is now the measured outcome. Recommend closing this epic on:
  - brain-scale diagonal / identity metrics SUPPORTED - same 52k volume, 166 s end to end
  - dense local metrics at whole-brain node counts NOT SUPPORTED in 0.1, exceeds 30 minutes
  - a declared dense-metric ceiling in node count and support size, found by re-running the gate at
    reduced node counts until it fits
Full numbers on bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT.
